'''Spir Fraxis''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the band of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bandin Dobah]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a quarrel with a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] when he tried to dredge [[Zukata]], a female [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. He was later killed by the same group when they succeeded in releasing [[R4-W9]], an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series agromech droid]] stolen by [[Bandin Dobah]].
